svg.title: Four rollout phases listed vertically with their exit criteria beside each
svg.desc: A black canvas shows four horizontal rows labeled pilot, expand, standardize, and govern, each with a short exit criterion listed beside it in acid-yellow text, illustrating that each phase requires a specific, checkable condition before the next phase begins.
svg.text: EACH PHASE HAS AN EXIT CRITERION

g.text: exit: proven value on one real workflow
exit: alert precision above agreed bar
exit: new workflow onboards on shared schema
exit: every workflow has a named owner

svg.text: uncoil.dev · a phase without a checkable exit criterion is a phase that never actually ends
